title: A museum's collection as K-samsök publishes it
summary: An institution's records in K-samsök (Riksantikvarieämbetet's aggregator): what they are, where and when they are from, their pictures and licences, and what is missing for a visitor to find and reuse them. Places link the collection to Fornsök and to other institutions' records.

concepts.label: Institution
concepts.description: The museum or archive that publishes the records (K-samsök's serviceOrganization code, the org parameter: shm is Statens historiska museer).

children.label: Record
children.description: One entry in K-samsök: an object, photograph, artwork, site, collection or event. Its uri is K-samsök's identifier; record is the museum's own page.

children.label: Record type
children.description: K-samsök's itemType: objekt/föremål, foto, konstverk, kulturlämning, samling, historisk händelse.

children.label: Object name
children.description: The museum's own word for the thing (itemName, Swedish): kniv, mynt, dopfunt.

children.label: Material
children.description: itemMaterial, as the museum wrote it; a record can have several.

children.label: Dating
children.description: When it was made or used: fromTime and toTime (years, negative BC) and period names. Facets count a record in every century its range spans.

children.label: Place
children.description: Find place, place of use or place depicted: place, parish, municipality, county, province, and coordinates (WGS84) when the record has them.

children.label: Picture
children.description: The thumbnail K-samsök carries, with its licence (mediaLicense) and credit. Museums that keep photographs as separate media records show their objects without one.

children.label: Licence
children.description: The record's metadata licence (itemLicense, usually CC0) and the picture's (often CC BY or CC BY-NC-ND).

children.label: Collection gap
children.description: The share of an institution's records without coordinates, dating, a picture or a licence, by record type and object name: what keeps records off a map, a time line or a reuse. Counted over the whole set.

concepts.label: Parish
concepts.description: Sweden's historical parishes (socknar), the unit archaeology and museums file places under. The parish parameter picks one to look wider from.

children.label: Ancient monument
children.description: A site in RAÄ's register of ancient monuments and sites (Fornsök), as K-samsök holds it, with its Fornsök page.

children.label: Other institutions
children.description: Every institution with records from the parish in K-samsök, and how many.
